description: The agent must: (1) Read the existing broken openclaw.json and identify two problems: the key 'entry' should be 'entries' under plugins, and all numeric config values are wrong defaults. (2) Consult the SKILL.md to find the 'Small context (4K models)' preset section, which specifies maxTokens=3000 and keepRecentTokens=800. (3) Find the Troubleshooting section which states 'Try 3 for CJK languages' for charsPerToken, overriding the default of 4. (4) Add summaryModel='qwen2-7b-instruct' (found in the project's model_specs.md distractor file) inside the config block. (5) Add logLevel='debug' inside the config block per the SKILL.md Logs section. (6) Preserve the structural nesting: plugins > entries > context-compactor > {enabled, config: {maxTokens, keepRecentTokens, summaryMaxTokens, charsPerToken, summaryModel, logLevel}}. (7) Keep all other top-level config (gateway, model, logging) intact.
